main_text.l: כרוּבָא Ch. Grando major, Psal. 78. 47. Hebr. חַנָּמַל.
כַּרְזְבָא Chald. Species locustæ, cicada, vel cantharus,
Resp. Hebr. חָגָב Lev. 11. 22. in Targ. Jon. Sic habent
Veneta. Elias & Baal Aruch legerunt כְּרוּבָא.
* כָּרַח Cogere, urgere aliquem.
כְּרָחָא Ch. Vis, coactio, בְּעַל כּוּרְחָךְ Per coactionem tui,
id est, te invito, 1. Sam. 2. 16.
כָּרַךְ Ch. & Syr. Involvere, obvolvere, convolve-
re, complicare, operire, cooperire, tegere: I-
tem Munire, Jerem. 51. 53. Item Alligare, annecte-
re, Prover. 6. 21. Ithpeh. אִתְכְּרַךְ Involvi: Syr. ܟܪܟ
Circumagi, circumire, peragrare, pertransfire, Aphel
ܐܟܪܟ Circumducere, 1. ad Cor. 9. 5. Pahel כָּרֵךְ Ope-
rire, cooperire, tegere, obvolvere, involvere: Item
Circumire, verti, converti, ex significatione Syria-
ca, Prov. 26. 14.
כְּרִיכָא, כָּרִיךְ Ch. & Syr. Convolutus, involutus: Muni-
tus. Plur. כְּרִיכִין. Fœm. כְּרִיכְתָּא Munita, Jesa. 36. 1. Plu. כְּרִיכָן.
כַּרְכָּא כָּרֵךְ Ch. ܟܪܟܐ Syr. Munitio, arx, urbs munita.
Plur. כַּרְכָּיָא, כַּרְכִּין, Syr. ܟܪܟܐ, Affine est Græc. χάρξ.
כַּרְכּוֹם Chal. Idem. Plur. כַּרְכּוֹמִין Deut. 20. 20. in Onk.
convenit Græc. χαρχωμα.
ܟܪܟܢ Syr. Involucrum, fasciculus, 2. ad Tim. 4. 13.
